derivation.method: Authored from the pinned Steel Compendium only (canonical checkout at the main repo vendor/steel-compendium, HEAD fb83a789 verified with git rev-parse). Level-one baselines from tests/fixtures/v104-elementalist-expected.json (reviewed). No evaluator, content, convex or headless code read or run.
derivation.staminaMaximum: Elementalist Basics: Starting Stamina 18 + 6 per level after 1st; plus Enchantment of Permanence +6 (steps at 4th/7th/10th only) and, for Earth, Disciple of Earth +6 at 2nd and +3 per level past 2nd (+9 at 3rd). Enchantment of Battle light-armor +3 stays conditional/excluded (as v104). Elementalists have no kit Stamina.
derivation.numericSheetChanges: EXPLICIT: the only level-2/3 features that change numeric sheet values are (1) Disciple of Earth (Earth: v104-2, v104-5): Stamina +6 at level 2, +9 at level 3, with derived recovery/winded values; (2) Disciple of Fire (Fire: v104-1): fire immunity 7 at level 2 and 8 at level 3. Plus the class Stamina +6 per level for everyone. Disciple of the Green, There Is No Space Between, all 3rd-level specialization features, every 5/7-essence ability and every selected perk change no numeric sheet value (recoveries, speed, stability, disengage, characteristics, potency, immunities). Acolyte of Earth stability (+1 per Earth+Magic ability use until start of next turn) and Acolyte of the Green temporary Stamina are transient, not sheet values.
derivation.abilityCounts: Advancement table: level 2 adds a second 5-essence ability (Two signature, 3, 5, 5); level 3 adds one 7-essence ability (Two signature, 3, 5, 5, 7). Void also gains There Is No Space Between at 2nd; Earth gains Earth Accepts Me and Green gains Remember Growth and Sun and Rain at 3rd (no-cost specialization abilities).
derivation.abilityDamage: 'X + R' adds Reason (all witnesses R2). Enchantment of Destruction +1 rolled damage with magic abilities (Magic keyword) and Acolyte of Fire +1 rolled damage for Fire+Magic abilities apply only to v104-1 and only to power-rolled damage. Enchantment of Battle's +1 needs a weapon ability and wielded light weapon (never here). Fixed (non-rolled) damage recorded under fixedDamageByWitness.
derivation.potency: Weak R-2 / Average R-1 / Strong R = 0/1/2 with Reason 2 (class/elementalist.md Basics).
derivation.perkChoice: One distinct eligible perk per witness from crafting/lore/supernatural (feature/elementalist/level-2/perk.md), none with sub-choices, none already owned (all bases own only Teamwork, an exploration perk). Perks grant no numeric change.
derivation.fiveEssenceChoice: v104-1..v104-4 take one of the four new level-2 options; v104-5 takes Conflagration through the 'didn't select at 1st level' alternative (it picked No More Than a Breeze at 1st).

uncertainties.passage: en/unified/md/feature/elementalist/level-1/enchantment-of-distance.md "+2 bonus to the distance of your ranged magic abilities" and void-acolyte-of-the-mystery.md "distance of all your abilities that have the Magic, Ranged, and Void keywords increases by 2 squares".
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: the two are separate features and both apply, so v104-4's Translated Through Flame, Erase and There Is No Space Between are Ranged 14. rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties.md says bonuses always add together (stated for power rolls); no passage forbids stacking distance bonuses.

uncertainties.passage: en/unified/md/feature/elementalist/level-2/disciple-of-earth.md "+6 bonus to Stamina ... additional +3 ... whenever you gain a level past 2nd"; enchantment-of-permanence.md "+6 bonus to Stamina".
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: both Stamina bonuses apply to v104-2 (36 at level 2, 45 at level 3). The +3 per level past 2nd gives +9 total at 3rd.
alternatives: bonuses from different features do not stack (v104-2 would be 30 / 39) - no supporting passage found

uncertainties.passage: en/unified/md/feature/elementalist/level-1/enchantment-of-battle.md "While you wear light armor, you gain a +3 bonus to Stamina".
uncertainties.resolution: Kept conditional and excluded, matching the reviewed v104 baseline (v104-5 level 1 Stamina 18). v104-5 levels 2/3: 30 / 39.

uncertainties.resolution: Not resolved; kept manual. The initial use (7 essence) triggers temporary Stamina 2; the persistent re-roll is ambiguous because the ability still has a cost but no essence is spent.

re-roll does not trigger (no essence spent)
